Exact crop of the published Players Committee sheet, PDF page 8: the front of [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]] (Infiltration) in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012 (the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012). It prints the original front text (“… "Luke" on opponent's [Reflections II] objective is treated as "Rebel Agent." …”).<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Published sheet]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
